# Spotiglass v0.6.0
Spotiglass can finally search Spotify itself, not just the library you already have.
## Highlights
- **A dedicated Search surface.** A new **Search** row sits at the top of the sidebar and opens a full-window view for searching Spotify's catalog: tracks, albums, artists, and playlists. Filter by category, page through results, and open any result the same way you would from your library. - **Cmd+F opens Search, and you can change it.** The shortcut is registered as a normal editable command, so it appears in **Settings → Keyboard**, can be rebound, and takes part in conflict detection. Nothing is hardcoded. - **The command palette hands off instead of competing.** Cmd+K behaves exactly as before, and palette results now end with **Show all results for your query**, which opens the Search view carrying your text and category. - **Readable controls in background windows.** A selected filter pill drew as a white capsule with a white label when its window was not focused, which made the active category invisible. Labels on accent-filled controls now pick their color from the fill, so they stay readable whether the window is focused or not.
## Reliability
- The formatter configuration was invalid, so `make format` and `make lint` had never run for anyone. Both work now, and the violations they surfaced are fixed. - A test file had never been added to the test target, so four component tests had never compiled or run once. They are part of the suite now.
## Install
1. Download `Spotiglass-0.6.0.dmg` below. 2. Open the disk image and drag **Spotiglass.app** into **Applications**. 3. Launch Spotiglass normally. No Control-click or quarantine-removal workaround is required.
Existing users will be offered the update automatically through Sparkle.
Spotify **Premium** is required for Web Playback SDK streaming.
## Support
Tips fund fixes and future releases: <https://buymeacoffee.com/isaaclins>
Full change list in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/isaaclins/spotiglass/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

# Spotiglass v0.5.0
A native-Mac release focused on making Spotiglass look, behave, and distribute like a first-party macOS app.
## Highlights
- **Settings now uses native grouped forms.** Equalizer, Playback, Appearance, Keyboard, and Account use consistent macOS sections, label columns, insets, and scrolling. - **A real Mac menu bar.** The new **Playback** menu exposes play/pause, next, previous, shuffle, repeat, and connection actions. View and File menus include queue, lyrics, refresh, and library-loading commands, with shortcuts linked to your editable keymap. - **Native playlist track tables.** Playlist tracks now use the macOS table implementation, bringing native selection, Shift and Command multi-select, arrow-key navigation, double-click playback, and correct context-menu focus rings. A 1,000-track playlist still realizes only the visible rows. - **Better accessibility and discoverability.** Icon-only controls now provide concise hover tooltips and VoiceOver labels across playback, queue, browser, breadcrumbs, pinning, lyrics, and shortcut settings. - **Correct background-window appearance.** Custom accent controls become neutral when a window is inactive, while warnings and artwork remain visible. Selection also de-emphasizes when keyboard focus moves elsewhere. - **Quieter copy.** Command palette and queue section headers use locale-appropriate capitalization instead of all caps. - **Trusted distribution.** The app, Sparkle components, equalizer driver, and disk image are signed with Developer ID, hardened, notarized by Apple, and stapled for offline Gatekeeper verification.
## Reliability
- Unit tests can no longer overwrite the real Spotify client ID, playback volume, or app-storage preferences. - Release tooling validates version progression, keeps historical Sparkle download URLs pinned to their original tags, and refuses to publish an unsigned or unnotarized artifact.
## Install
1. Download `Spotiglass-0.5.0.dmg` below. 2. Open the disk image and drag **Spotiglass.app** into **Applications**. 3. Launch Spotiglass normally. No Control-click or quarantine-removal workaround is required.
Existing users will be offered the update automatically through Sparkle.
Spotify **Premium** is required for Web Playback SDK streaming.
